mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase oxacillin metabolism, potentially reducing antibiotic efficacy; oxacillin may also induce cenobamate metabolism leading to subtherapeutic antiepileptic levels.
action: Monitor seizure control and antibiotic efficacy; consider alternative antibiotics with less enzyme interaction potential or adjust cenobamate dosing if needed; ensure adequate dosing of oxacillin if used concurrently.
